id: title:ablaszkiewicz:leave script file paths out of the event mode content hash

observations.behavior: Adds a markdown changelog entry explaining the release-mode sourcemap upload behavior change.
observations.code_quote: In event release mode, `sourcemap upload` no longer uploads unchanged chunks again when the bundler names chunks by content, as Vite does by default. Every chunk carries the release id, so every release renamed every chunk, and the content hash covered those names: the map's `file`, the `sourceMappingURL` comment and imports of other chunks. The hash now leaves out script file paths (ending in `.js`, `.mjs` or `.cjs`). Hashes stored by earlier versions include the paths, so the first upload after updating sends each chunk once more.
observations.posthog_connection: This is a release note, not implementation. It does not demonstrate the mechanism, so no score.
